what: A solid ledge in the same color as the border sits .3rem below the button only, floating, and on hover it drops straight down by the ledge height so the ledge becomes 0 (.3s ease) — on release it floats back up. On touch it drops only while pressed. A neighborhood academy site where the round pill menu, big contact button and review cards are all the same ”pressed plate”

options.--fx-depth: Ledge height = Settling distance (via style), default .3rem
options.--fx-ledge: Ledge color (via style), default border color --kf-line — if the base is a different color from the border (white panel on a yellow base), use var(--kf-accent)

note: The original applies hover only at 768px and up — here it is split with (hover: hover). Corner radius and size come from the consuming css

from.where: shared.css .a-push (header pill button · menu panel cell · contact button · review card — 0 .3rem 0 ledge, on hover translateY(.3rem) · ledge 0, .3s)

shared.css .tk-btn (see details — ink-bordered plate over a yellow/white base) · sub.css .tk-town__btn (ride button) · .tk-logo · .tk-menubtn (logo box · menu circle) — base .625em (rides .5625rem) lies underneath, on hover the plate moves over the base .2s cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1)
